decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 23/09/2005, the erection of a single storey rear outbuilding measuring with a width of 7m, a depth of 4m and a height of 3.674m was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:

The development falls within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class E of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 because the ridge of the outbuilding is less than 4m in height, the buildings take up less than 50 percent of the garden area and the outbuilding is more than 5m from the original house.  
Condition : 2 - The detached outbuilding hereby found to be lawful shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the single-family dwellinghouse known as 17 Burns Way and for no other purpose (i.e. it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room, office or other business use or as a separate dwelling and should not include toilet, bathroom or kitchen facilities).
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of a single storey detached outbuilding to rear of house.
